step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all architecture components across Region 1 (Edge), Region 2 (Edge), and Main Region based on the whiteboard and context.
2. Assign string sequential integer IDs to nodes.
3. Identify the visual green arrows drawn on the whiteboard:
   - ELB (Region 1) -> ELB (Main Region): Verification request proxying.
   - ELB (Main Region) -> EC2 (Main Region): Route request to Certificate Manager running on EC2.
   - EC2 (Main Region) -> SNS (Main Region): Publish updated certificate data to SNS topic.
   - SNS (Main Region) -> SQS (Region 1) & SQS (Region 2): Decoupled pub/sub fan-out distribution.
   - SQS (Region 1) -> ECS (Region 1): Edge SQS queue passing certificate message to ECS consumer.
4. Organize these flows logically with flow IDs and sequence numbers.

graph.name: Strikingly - Multi-Region Custom Domain SSL Certificate Management and Distribution
graph.notes: Strikingly's global multi-region architecture for managing and dynamically distributing SSL certificates for tens of thousands of custom user domains using AWS SNS, SQS, ECS, and EC2 Certificate Manager.

nodes.name: ECS (Region 1)

nodes.name: ElastiCache (Region 1)
nodes.notes: In-memory cache storing downloaded SSL certificates for edge SSL handshakes.

nodes.name: SQS (Region 1)
nodes.notes: Subscribed to central SNS topic to receive new certificate notifications.

nodes.name: ElastiCache (Region 2)
nodes.notes: In-memory cache storing downloaded SSL certificates in Region 2.

nodes.name: SQS (Region 2)
nodes.notes: Subscribed to central SNS topic in Region 2 for plug-and-play fanout.

nodes.name: ELB (Main Region)
nodes.notes: Main Region Load Balancer routing cross-region verification requests.

nodes.name: EC2 (Main Region)
nodes.notes: Hosts Certificate Manager which orchestrates domain validation and issuance.

nodes.name: SNS (Main Region)
nodes.notes: Central topic publishing certificate updates globally across edge regions.

nodes.name: RDS (Main Region)

edges.notes: Proxies domain verification request from Region 1 ELB to Main Region ELB.
Main Region ELB forwards verification proxy request to Certificate Manager on EC2.
Certificate Manager publishes new certificate data to central SNS topic.
SNS fans out certificate message to SQS queue in Region 1.
SNS fans out certificate message to SQS queue in Region 2.
Region 1 SQS passes consumed certificate message to ECS consumer instance.
